# `reint`

Reintegrate markers previously removed from the processed AnnData

- Wrapper: [`job_reintegrate.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_reintegrate.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_segmentation`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.reintegrate_markers`

## Inputs

- process.output_adata_path + segmentation.removed_markers_anndata_path

## Outputs

- process.output_adata_path (updated in place)
- outputs/016_Marker_Reintegration/<run_id>/ stage report

## Configuration

- general, segmentation, process, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl reint
```
